trust_decision.summary: Whether a principal may make the datasource proxy attach a stored secret's credentials: it must hold read on the secret's own authorization scope (Secret in the datasource's project, GlobalSecret globally), decided both where a datasource spec is saved (Create/Update services) and where an unsaved spec is proxied; saved-datasource proxying keeps requiring only Datasource read.

landing_point.why: The advisory says 'missing authorization in datasource proxy'; the first place an engineer lands is the unsaved project-datasource handler, where the only check (Datasource:create) sits one line above the call at :58 that builds the proxy and fetches the secret named in the caller-supplied spec.

fix_sites.module_kind: API service / persistence layer (second implementation of the datasource write path)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the datasource proxy, and global datasources are a separate admin-only feature with its own scope (GlobalSecret), so the global CRUD service in another package can be argued to be out of the reported path.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A user holding only Datasource read must keep proxying through an existing datasource whose attached secret they cannot read; the saved handlers deliberately pass a retrieveSecret closure with no secret check, so a check pushed down into newProxy/getProjectSecret would deny legitimate reads.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: internal/api/impl/proxy/projectdatasource.go:61-74; internal/api/impl/proxy/globaldatasource.go:61-73; internal/api/impl/proxy/proxy.go:211-228; fix.diff:263-265 (secretless datasources must also stay allowed)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Create/Update a dashboard whose embedded spec.datasources[i].plugin.spec names an existing project secret; the saved dashboard-datasource proxy route then attaches that secret's credentials to an attacker-chosen URL/host, so a caller with Datasource read but no Secret read discloses the secret.
O8_uncovered_routes.where: internal/api/impl/v1/dashboard/service.go:57-63,79-85 (validation only at internal/api/validate/validate.go:134-147); sink reached from internal/api/impl/proxy/localdatasource.go:62-77 through getDashboardDatasource at internal/api/impl/proxy/localdatasource.go:79-95
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Dashboards are not datasources and the report says 'datasource proxy'; the dashboard spec is schema-validated at write time, so it looks like a different, already-checked feature - and the fix did add a check to the unsaved dashboard proxy route, making the area look covered.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: from the proxy handlers in internal/api/impl/proxy to internal/api/impl/v1/dashboard and internal/api/validate: 3 files, 3 packages

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Ephemeral-dashboard create/update storing embedded datasources that name secrets, plus a mirrored ephemeral-dashboard datasource proxy route
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: EphemeralDashboardSpec embeds dashboard.Spec (pkg/model/api/v1/ephemeraldashboard.go:50-53) and its service is a near copy of the dashboard service, so a maintainer writing the dashboard fix would plausibly copy the same shape here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A third proxy kind carrying a secret name that is not added to checkSecretPermission's two-case switch
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Both services' checks enumerate only HTTPProxy and SQLProxy; adding a kind to the shared extractor is a one-line change that silently bypasses the new check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A fourth proxy route family (e.g. a project datasource allowed to fall back to a global secret, or a saved route for ephemeral dashboards)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The proxy already has three parallel handler families with separate project/global secret lookups, so another copy is a natural maintainer addition.

O9_family: missing authorization (CWE-862) on secret use by the datasource proxy

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.26.2 (go.mod:3); Node/pnpm only for ui/; default plugins installed by 'make install-default-plugins' (scripts/plugin/install_plugin.go:34-54 downloads from GitHub, so build-time network)
O10_build.project_tests: Unit tests internal/api/impl/proxy/{proxy_test.go,readonly_query_test.go,sql_response_test.go}; integration proxy tests under build tag integration at internal/api/e2e/api/proxy_test.go (they point at localhost:9090 Prometheus and localhost:5432 Postgres, so those tests need local services); the e2e framework supports native authorization with users/global roles (internal/api/e2e/framework/server.go:78-92,142-155), so the permission behaviour is testable offline with an httptest upstream; no existing test covers secret permission on any datasource route.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the Secret:read check only in proxyUnsavedProjectDatasource, mirroring the report's project-datasource example, leaving the global and dashboard unsaved routes, the globaldatasource service and the dashboard save path open.
